SP-024.1: a1 (commit ab1a100): internal/rag TestWritesForASpaceTouchOnlyItsCollection passes: a write placed in acme, made against a recording fake Qdrant that already holds collections for globex, quarantine and the base, sends every write request (collection create, payload indexes, upsert, prune) to c__acme only; the other collections receive no write of any kind and keep every point, and the only request any of them sees is a points/count filtered on the write's own source_uri (the lookup for an older copy, since a source lives in one space). Default segments, 2 quiet runs: baseline p95 18.06 / 18.03 ms, space collections p95 19.46 / 20.19 ms, ratio 1.08x / 1.12x (a third run under load: 32.59 vs 26.20 ms, 0.80x).
